description: Land Title Settlement Department - Baduragoda, Meerigama D/S Division,  Gampaha District   - Cad Map No. 510204
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and land characteristics) in the Gampaha District. The content focuses entirely on land registration, ownership determination, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
